findings.evidence: `grep -rn "trivial_toScheme" TauCeti/` returns nothing; Trivial.lean:71-72 inlines the statement as a local `have`.
findings.fix: Restore `@[simp] lemma trivial_toScheme : (trivial K).toScheme = Spec (.of K) := by simp [toScheme, trivial_toOver, Over.tensorUnit_left]` and use it in `trivial_dim` instead of the inline `have`.
findings.issue: `trivial_toScheme` no longer exists; the fact the module docstring advertises (line 22, "underlying scheme `Spec K`") survives only as a local `have h` inside `trivial_dim`'s proof, so no consumer can state that `(trivial K).toScheme = Spec (.of K)`. The author's reply asserts this lemma was kept as `(rfl)`; it was in fact removed.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:141-175 supplies the full transported API precisely so `ofGeometricallyIntegral` need not unfold; Trivial.lean:62 is the only new call site.
findings.fix: Revert `ofGeometricallyIntegral` to unexposed (its `eqToHom`-based `ofGeometricallyIntegral_{toOver,one,mul,inv}` API is what other consumers use) and write `trivial` as a direct structure literal (`toOver := 𝟙_ _; grpObj := inferInstance; ...`); `trivial` is already `@[expose]`, so its projections reduce without touching Basic.lean.
findings.issue: `@[expose]` is added to the pre-existing shared constructor `ofGeometricallyIntegral`, widening the public surface of Basic.lean for every consumer, only so that `trivial`'s body reduces. The defeq the author needs is `(trivial K).toOver ≡ 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of K)))`, which does not require the constructor to be transparent.

summary: The `@[expose]`/`rfl` findings from the prior round are withdrawn on the author's evidence, but the characteristic lemma `trivial_toScheme` was deleted rather than kept, and the exposure was widened to the shared `ofGeometricallyIntegral` constructor when a direct structure literal would confine it to `trivial`.
